title: Vertical Anchor
description: A vertical anchor defines a point in the dimension to offset from. Used as the 'value' (for constant height providers) or as 'min' and 'max' bounds (for uniform height providers). Exactly one of the four anchor properties below should be set.

fields.title: Above Bottom
fields.description: A relative height above the bottom of the dimension. Must be positive.

fields.title: Below Top
fields.description: A relative height below the top of the dimension. Must be positive.

fields.title: From Sea
fields.description: A relative height starting at the dimension's sea level.
